name: City Council Meeting
agenda_text:
November 19, 2019
6:30
PM
Council Chambers of City Hall
340 Palos Verdes Drive West
Palos Verdes Estates, CA 90274
AGENDA
OF A REGULAR MEETING
OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF
PALOS VERDES ESTATES, CALIFORNIA 90274
Copies of the staff reports or other written documentation relating to each item of business referred to on the agenda are on file in the office of the City Clerk and are available for public inspection. If applicable, materials related to an item on this agenda submitted to the Council after distribution of the agenda packet are available for public inspection in the City Clerk's office during normal business hours. Any person having any question concerning any agenda item may call the City Clerk to make inquiry concerning the item. Upon request, the agenda and documents in the agenda packet can be made available in appropriate alternative formats to persons with a disability in compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act. Please contact the City Clerk at 310-378-0383, at least 48 hours prior to the meeting to request a disability-related modification or accommodation.
The City Council welcomes and encourages public participation at the Council meetings; however, to allow for the orderly progression of business, each person wishing to comment or make a presentation shall be limited to up to three (3) minutes. Anyone wishing to address the City Council is requested to fill out a green speaker's card available at the entry of the meeting room. The card permits the City to identify persons for purposes of City Council minute preparation. Please see specific agenda sections below for any other requirements related to meeting participation. The City Council, at the direction of the Mayor with concurrence of the Council, may modify the order of items shown on the agenda.
NEXT RESOLUTION NO. R19-35
NEXT ORDINANCE NO. O19-741
CALL TO ORDER
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE
ROLL CALL
APPROVAL OF AGENDA
MAYOR’S REPORT – MATTERS OF COMMUNITY INTEREST
CONSENT AGENDA (ITEMS 1 – 9)
1.
Draft City Council Action Minutes Recommendation: Review and Approve.
a.
November 5, 2019 Closed Session
Minutes
b.
November 5, 2019 Regular Session
Minutes
2.
Demands of November 19, 2019 Recommendation: Approve payment of Motions #1 & #2
a.
Motion #1 – Payroll Warrant of November 15, 2019
Demands
b.
Motion #2 – Warrant Register of November 19, 2019
Demands
3.
Amendment to Interim City Manager Contract
Recommendation: It is recommended the City Council approve Amendment No 1 to the May 28, 2019 Contract with the Interim City Manager.
Staff Report
4.
Monthly Investment Report
Recommendation: Receive and File.
Staff Report
5.
FY19-20 Budget Update
Recommendation: It is recommended that the City Council receive and file this report.
Staff Report
6.
Acceptance of Donations
Recommendation: It is recommended the City Council accept the gifts as presented
Staff Report
7.
Adoption Upon Second Reading of Ordinance No. O19-739 Amending Section 17.08.378 (Short-Term or Vacation Rental) of Chapter 17.08 (Definitions) of Title 17 (Zoning Procedures) and Title 18 (Zoning Regulations) of the City’s Municipal Code Regulating Commercial Events
Recommendation: It is recommended that the City Council adopt upon second reading Ordinance No. O19-739 amending Section 17.08.378 (Short-Term or Vacation Rental) of Chapter 17.08 (Definitions) of Title 17 (Zoning Procedures) and Title 18 (Zoning Regulations) of the City’s municipal code regulating commercial events.
Staff Report
8.
Adoption Upon Second Reading of Ordinance No. O19-740 Amending Chapter 18.28 (Outdoor Lighting) of Title 18 (Zoning Regulations) of the City’s Municipal Code
Recommendation: It is recommended that the City Council adopt upon second reading Ordinance No. O19-740 amending Chapter 18.28 (Outdoor Lighting) of Title 18 (Zoning Regulations) of the City’s municipal code.
Staff Report
9.
Adoption of Resolution R19-34 Authorizing Application for and Receipt of, SB 2 Planning Grants Program Funds
Recommendation: It is recommended that the City Council adopt Resolution No. R19-34 authorizing application for, and receipt of, SB 2 planning grant program funds.
Staff Report
COMMUNICATIONS FROM THE PUBLIC
OLD BUSINESS
11.
Update and Discussion of the Activities of the Pension Ad Hoc Committee and the Police Operational Ad Hoc Committee
Recommendation: It is recommended the City Council receive updates from the Council Ad Hoc Committees, discuss the status of their work, and provide any direction Council deems appropriate.
Staff Report
12.
Discussion of the Los Angeles Consolidated Fire Protection District 2020 Ballot Measure
Recommendation: Adopt Resolution R19-33 authorizing the Interim City Manager to issue a written notice to the Fire District that the City of Palos Verdes Estates authorizes the Fire Department to include the City of Palos Verdes Estates within a 2020 ballot measure to provide funding for critical fire protection and emergency medical services.
Staff Report
ORDINANCE/PUBLIC HEARING(S)
10.
Introduction on First Reading of Ordinance 19-741 Amending Title 15 (Buildings And Construction) of the Palos Verdes Estates Municipal Code by Adopting by Reference the 2019 California Building, Residential, Electrical, Mechanical, Plumbing, Energy, Green Building, Historical Building and Existing Building Codes; the 2016 California Referenced Standards, the 2015 International Property Maintenance Code; the 2015 Uniform Swimming Pool, Spa, and Hot Tub Code; the 2015 Uniform Solar Energy and Hydronics Code; Amending Chapter 8.12 (Fire Code) of Title 8 (Health And Safety) of the Palos Verdes Estates Municipal Code by Adopting by Reference the 2017 Los Angeles County Fire Code, Ratifying the More Restrictive Building Standards Contained in that Code, and Delegating Enforcement of the Fire Code in the City to the Fire Chief; and Adding a New Chapter 13.14 ("Sanitary Sewer And Industrial Waste") to Title 13 (Public Services) of the Palos Verdes Estates Municipal Code to Adopt by Reference the Los Angeles County Sanitary Sewers and Industrial Waste Ordinance (Title 20, Division 2 - Los Angeles County Code)
Recommendation: It is recommended that the City Council open the public hearing, receive public input, close the public hearing, and introduce upon first reading Ordinance 19-741, amending Title 15 of the Palos Verdes Estates Municipal Code by adopting by reference the new 2019 California Building Code and other related Codes addressing construction activities, sanitary sewer/industrial waste and fire and life safety building standards.
Staff Report
11.
Update and Discussion of the Activities of the Pension Ad Hoc Committee and the Police Operational Ad Hoc Committee
Recommendation: It is recommended the City Council receive updates from the Council Ad Hoc Committees, discuss the status of their work, and provide any direction Council deems appropriate.
NEW BUSINESS
13.
Consideration of Proposed Single -Family Residential Solid Waste and Recycling Rate Adjustment for Refuse and Recycling Collection by Athens Services and Setting of a Public Hearing to Approve the Rate Adjustment
Recommendation: Staff recommends that City Council consider options and provide direction to staff.
Staff Report
STAFF REPORTS
i.
City Manager's Report
MAYOR, CITY COUNCILMEMBERS AND AD HOC COMMITTEE REPORTS
This portion of the agenda is reserved for the Mayor and Councilmembers to provide comments, report on community activities and ad hoc committees, and propose topics to be calendared on a future Council agenda.
ADJOURNMENT TO TUESDAY, DECEMBER 10, 2019, AT 6:30 P.M. IN THE COUNCIL CHAMBERS FOR THE PURPOSE OF A REGULAR MEETING.
ii.
This City Council meeting can be viewed via live-stream or on demand thereafter on the City Website at www.pvestates.org
I hereby certify under penalty of perjury under the laws of the State of California, that the foregoing agenda was posted on the City's website, City Hall Bulletin Boards located by front door and inside adjacent to Council Chambers located at 340 Palos Verdes Drive West, Palos Verdes Estates, CA 90274, Palos Verdes Golf Club, and Malaga Cove Library not less than 24 hours prior to the meeting in accordance with Government Code Section 54954.2 and copies were served as required by that statute. Dated this 15th day of November 2019.
Karina Bañales on behalf of Lauren Pettit, City Clerk
